comment: FEAT-2326609834 composition-root constants for engine.social (placeholders, Aaron's balance pass; GR#15: no hidden Go literals).
deprivationComment: Area deprivation index [0,1] fed to social every month: no deprivation model exists in the engine yet, so this is a documented citywide placeholder.
nightlifeDensityComment: Nightlife density [0,1]: no nightlife model exists yet; documented placeholder.
familyStressComment: Citywide persons-per-room and rent-burden handed to engine.wellbeing's real Crowding/FinancialStress drivers (no per-citizen housing figure reaches compose yet).
unemploymentMonthsComment: UnemploymentMonths driver = round(unemployed share of the live labour force x this); the mean long-term-unemployment months equivalent of the real unemployment rate.
caseDurationComment: An open case is resolved after a duration interpolated linearly on the category's funding level: funded prevention/hostels/housing-first close cases faster, so a funded net makes the caseload shallower.
initialFundingComment: Funding level [0,1] each social category starts a new city at (engine.services registers every service unfunded; the player raises or cuts it afterwards).
supportComment: Monthly support transfer per open case, scaled by the category's funding level (treasury -> households). RESCALED 2026-10-31 (r2 rework) from 200000000 to 1000000 = GBP 1/case/month to sit in the fiscal money regime (fiscal benefit is 600000/person); PLACEHOLDER flagged for Aaron's balance pass (ASM-284 / BUG-355 class). Validation caps it at 100x this value.
